reasons.plausibility: It is scientifically grounded and aligns with known effects of chemical complexity on phonon scattering, though near-temperature invariance may be slightly idealized.
reasons.testability: It proposes clear and established experimental methods to separately measure lattice and electronic contributions across a defined temperature range.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a key gap in modeling thermal transport in high-entropy alloys and outlines a clear path to verify and refine predictive tools.
